title: Haru and the Paper That Told the Truth
subtitle: One Print Shop, One Windy Winter and One True Sentence
blurb: Eleven-year-old Haru lives above a family print shop on Owl Alley, where her father carves wooden blocks and a small one-page news sheet tells the neighbors what really happened. Across the alley a bigger shop prints thrilling stories that sell five times as fast. When a windy night brings a fire and a false sheet blames the wrong man, Haru must tell a hard truth: bravely, and kindly, at the same time.
